blockers.detail: 72 files listed in heartgold.us/filesystem.sha1 are not in the checkout (mostly files/a/*/*/*); they exist only after extracting a legally owned HeartGold ROM. 645 SPL archives that ARE present (files/a/0/2/9 move particles, files/a/0/9/5 ball particles, ...) are decoded; the absent entries cannot be ruled out as holding more.
593 cell banks / sheets render but are held at STRUCTURAL_ONLY because their NCLR is not adjacent; the mapping lives in overlay code, not the NARC.
82 effect sprites select palette rows the file does not define; the engine supplies them at run time. Geometry/pixels are decoded for the metaframes that resolve; the rest are never guessed.
not part of effect.bin; not decoded by DAU1
1191 .spa archives decode to their particle textures only; emitter behaviour (velocity, scale/alpha curves, timing) is inventoried (emitter counts/bytes) but not decoded.
1333 screen maps in 118 archives are background compositions; no decoder (not effect art).
2 .ntft textures have palette-valid indices but an ambiguous width (not stored in the file).
33 of 97 battle objects are not reconstructable from text tables alone (placeholder gfx 0 = battler sprites, run-time palettes, or OAM tile offsets into a gfx loaded together with another).
the 2bpp sheets decode, but Yellow's layout tables (engine/battle/animations) were not reconstructed; Crystal was the single reconstructed recipe family.
pokemon_opal_everyday_moves_b9_manifest_v2 (names of the 19 P1 / 14 P2 moves) is not in the repo or the DAU1 package; the matrix is role-keyed.
no donor project grants rights over the original game artwork; PROVENANCE.md flags every pool for owner review before any public release.
